final: SELECT g.orderflow, g.avg_fill, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM (SELECT o.orderflow AS orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.orderflow) g CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(c.cnt) AS total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.orderflow) c) t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.orderflow
